$comment: Structure-guard registries (spec 0009 §7). Two registries with different jobs live here; web/eslint.config.mjs reads neither and switches no rule off by path. (1) `files` = the FILE-SIZE baseline: files above the hard line budget, read by scripts/check-file-size.mjs, only-shrink (a listed file may get smaller, never bigger; each entry carries a `reviewBy` date, see spec 0009 §7.1/§7.3). (2) `eslintSuppressions` = the BUDGET for the RULE-level registry in web/eslint-suppressions.json — that registry is what actually exempts code (ESLint bulk suppressions) and scripts/check-suppressions.mjs enforces it: any growth (file count, entry count, per-rule violation count) fails, entries whose rule no longer fires must be pruned, the set of files carrying a max-lines exemption must match the file-size registry 1:1, and review dates must be set and honored. To update budgets after refactoring: node scripts/check-suppressions.mjs --print-budget, paste here, commit with the split.
